title: Now Centroamérica playing
style: anthemic synth-pop, stadium chant chorus, 128 BPM, male lead vocals, group call and response, bass line melody, octave bass synth, gated snare, punchy kick, brass stabs, arena tom fills, layered claps, vocoder doubles, plate reverb, slapback delay, 80s power pop, modern club sheen, big final chorus, victorious energy
lyrics:
[Intro]
From Las Escadas…
San Juan del Sur…
Centroamérica…
This is our time!
[Verse 1]
Desde Las Escadas, the game is calling
Nicaragua ready, the spirit is rising
Pickleball growing, from the roots we came
Now Centroamérica playing the same game
Con pasión y fuerza, con el corazón
This is more than sport, this is who we are
From the Pacific waves to the land we love
We bring the fire, we rise above
[Pre-Chorus]
One game, one heart, one dream
Unidos por el pickleball, we live the dream
[Chorus]
From Las Escadas we play!
From Las Escadas we rise!
Centroamérica united, under the same sky
Come to Nicaragua, feel the energy
Play the game, live the dream, this is our destiny
From Las Escadas we play!
From Las Escadas we rise!
One heart, one court, one fire in our eyes
Ven a descubrir, ven a sentir
Nicaragua te espera, it’s time to live!
[Verse 2]
After the game, don’t stop the journey
Go to Ometepe, feel the volcano’s glory
Walk through Granada, history in the streets
Feel the soul of León where the fire still beats
Nicaragua is calling, with open arms
Beaches, volcanoes, culture and charm
This is not just a tournament, it’s an invitation
To play and explore a whole new nation
[Pre-Chorus]
One game, one heart, one dream
Unidos por el pickleball, we live the dream
[Chorus]
From Las Escadas we play!
From Las Escadas we rise!
Centroamérica united, under the same sky
Come to Nicaragua, feel the energy
Play the game, live the dream, this is our destiny
From Las Escadas we play!
From Las Escadas we rise!
One heart, one court, one fire in our eyes
Ven a descubrir, ven a sentir
Nicaragua te espera, it’s time to live!
[Bridge]
This is more than pickleball, this is connection
From every country, we come with passion
History, culture, and the spirit of the land
Nicaragua is waiting… come take my hand
[Final Chorus – Bigger]
From Las Escadas we play!
From Las Escadas we rise!
Centroamérica united, hear the battle cry
Come to Nicaragua, feel the energy
Play the game, live the dream — this is our destiny!
From Las Escadas… we play!
From Las Escadas… we rise!
One heart… one game… one fire in our eyes!
[Outro]
From Las Escadas…
Centroamérica…
Nicaragua…
One love, one game, one heart.
